assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: rig-ready master illustration for our original cut-out RPG character Biscuit. The sole input is our own approved Biscuit concept, not another game's art. Preserve this orange tabby cat's face identity, warm textured painterly finish, green eyes, cream baker hat with teal band and brass button, teal apron, cream shirt, brown belt, fluffy orange striped tail, biscuit shield and wooden spatula. Repose into a neutral three-quarter frontal stance suitable for separating animation parts: both arms angled slightly away from the torso so their whole outline is clear, full torso painted behind arms, both paws and feet visible, tail entirely visible away from the legs. Arrange the wooden spatula and biscuit shield as separate detached objects to the right of the cat with clear transparent space, no hand gripping them; the cat's paws should be neutral. Full body, ears and hat and feet uncropped, generous transparent margin. Simple neutral mouth. No background, floor, shadows behind the figure, labels, text, watermark, extra characters, or effects. Square 1024x1024 transparent image. This is an original rig-master pilot, retain the input's cozy painted quality and proportions.
assets.source: Our approved Biscuit concept: assets/source/look-v3/concepts/biscuit.png in cardrpg-b2; supplied only as local concept preview
